newsitem.title: UK: British Telecom stockholders to vote on MCI merger.
newsitem.headline: British Telecom stockholders to vote on MCI merger.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said Friday it would hold a meeting on April 15 for shareholders to approve its planned $20 billion merger with MCI Communications Corp .
The extraordinary general meeting will be held at Wembley Conference Centre in London.
BT said it would send the listing particulars and circular relating to the deal to shareholders on March 17.
The two telecommunications giants announced the deal in December.
